origin.description: Pipe a value forward and evaluate each step immediately.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: A value, or the dot placeholder.

arguments.name: rhs
arguments.text: A function or a call, using the same placement rules as %>%.

origin.details: %>% waits until a step's result is needed, so messages in a chain appear from the last function backward. %!>% evaluates the input at every step. NULL %!>% f() %!>% g() %!>% h(), when each function messages and then returns its argument, prints foo, then bar, then baz. %!>% is pipe_eager_lexical.
origin.value: The result of the chain, or a function when the left-hand side is the dot.

translation.description: Pipe a value through functions, running each step immediately.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: The starting value, or DOT to return a functional sequence.

arguments.name: steps
arguments.text: The same callable and (function, args, kwargs) steps as pipe.

translation.details: eager is pipe_eager_lexical. Each step receives the concrete result of the previous step before the next step starts, so prints run from the first function forward.
translation.value: The piped value, or an FSeq when lhs is DOT.
translation.example:
from magrittr.pipe import eager
eager(list(range(1, 11)), sum)
